name: Five-letter word deduction
summary: Guess a hidden 5-letter word in 6 tries; each guess colors letters green (right spot), yellow (in word) or grey (absent).
core_loop: type a 5-letter guess → letters color green, yellow or grey → narrow the word → solve within 6
rules: each guess must be a real word
green = right letter right spot, yellow = in word elsewhere, grey = not in word
social_hooks: Everyone gets the same daily word; post your color grid to the group chat and compare guess counts.
example_prompts: a wordle about our group's inside jokes

name: Letter honeycomb
summary: Make as many words as you can from 7 letters; every word must use the center letter. A pangram uses all seven.
core_loop: type a word from the 7 letters → it must use the center letter → points by length → climb ranks
rules: words must include the center letter
letters can repeat
minimum length 4
scoring: points by word length, pangram bonus
social_hooks: Group shares one puzzle and climbs rank titles together; shared found-words list.
example_prompts: spelling bee but with taylor swift words
nyt spelling bee clone for my book club

name: Anagram unscramble
summary: Unscramble jumbled letters into a word before the timer runs out.
core_loop: see scrambled letters → type the word → next scramble faster
rules: only the one intended word counts
timer per word
win: clear every word in the round
lose: timer runs out on a word
scoring: points per word plus time bonus
social_hooks: Head-to-head: same scrambles, fastest solver gets the point.
example_prompts: jumble but every word is a food

name: Find every word in a rack
summary: Given 6–7 letters, find all words that can be made; a full-length word clears the round.
core_loop: see a letter rack → type every word it makes → fill the slots → round clears
rules: words must use only rack letters
slots show how many words of each length remain
win: fill every slot, or the required ones
scoring: points per word, bonus for the longest
social_hooks: Co-op: friends split the word list and fill one shared board.
example_prompts: find all the words in these letters

name: Boggle-style grid search
summary: Trace adjacent letters in a 4x4 grid to spell words before time runs out; longer words score more.
core_loop: trace adjacent letters → submit a word → keep hunting until time
rules: letters must touch, including diagonals
each tile once per word
win: most points when the timer ends
social_hooks: Same grid for everyone; compare lists after the timer and cancel shared words.

name: Word search
summary: Find hidden words in a letter grid, horizontally, vertically or diagonally.
core_loop: scan the grid → drag across a hidden word → it locks in → find them all
rules: words can run in any straight line
letters can be shared between words
social_hooks: Make a word search out of your friends' names and send it to them.
example_prompts: word search with our friends names
word search of star wars characters

name: Themed word search with a hidden phrase
summary: Find theme words that fill the whole grid; a spanning word reveals the theme.
core_loop: find a theme word → it fills tiles → the spanning word reveals the theme → every tile used
rules: theme words use every tile exactly once
one word spans the board
social_hooks: Daily shared puzzle; post how many hints you used.
example_prompts: find the theme words that fill the board

name: Four groups of four
summary: Sort 16 words into 4 hidden groups of 4; 4 mistakes and you're out.
core_loop: pick 4 words you think share a link → submit → right groups lock, wrong ones cost a life → find all 4
rules: exactly 4 groups of 4
4 mistakes ends the game
social_hooks: Make a Connections board from your group's inside jokes and send it to them.
example_prompts: nyt connections about our friend group

name: Odd one out
summary: Pick the word that doesn't belong in each set.
core_loop: see a set → tap the one that doesn't fit → see the link → next set
rules: exactly one item breaks the shared link
social_hooks: Streak challenge: send your streak to a friend to beat.
example_prompts: odd one out with movie titles

name: Mini crossword
summary: Fill a 5x5 crossword from short clues.
core_loop: pick a clue → type the answer into the grid → crossings help → fill the grid
rules: across and down answers share letters
social_hooks: Fastest solve time leaderboard in the group.
example_prompts: a mini crossword about my dog
crossword with clues about our trip

name: Cryptic clues
summary: Solve one cryptic clue at a time where wordplay and a definition both point to the answer.
core_loop: read the clue → split definition from wordplay → type the answer → reveal the parse
rules: the answer satisfies both the definition and the wordplay
social_hooks: Share solve time and hints used; groups trade their own clues.
notes: Typed on the iPhone keyboard with typed_answer (one tier per clue: the answer); the drawn keyboard is only for letter-tile games.

name: Guess the letters
summary: Guess letters of a hidden word or phrase; too many misses and you lose.
core_loop: guess a letter → it fills in or costs a miss → guess the phrase before misses run out
rules: each wrong letter costs a miss
social_hooks: One friend writes the phrase, the other guesses.
example_prompts: wheel of fortune style phrase guessing
hangman but not dark, like a balloon popping

name: Category + starting letter
summary: Name a thing in each category that starts with the rolled letter before time runs out.
core_loop: see a letter and categories → type an answer for each → unique answers score
rules: answers must start with the letter
answers shared with others score zero
social_hooks: Unique answers score; duplicates across friends cancel out.
example_prompts: name a fruit starting with B

name: Typing race
summary: Type the shown text as fast and accurately as you can.
core_loop: read the passage → type it → speed and accuracy count → finish the passage
rules: mistakes must be fixed before moving on
win: finish first or beat the ghost
social_hooks: Race friends' ghosts on the same passage.
example_prompts: type fast to make the car go

name: Falling words
summary: Words fall from the top; type each before it lands.
core_loop: words fall → type one to destroy it → speed rises → keep the bottom clear
rules: a word that reaches the ground costs a life
social_hooks: Score attack with a group leaderboard.
example_prompts: type the zombies' words to stop them

name: Word chain
summary: Each new word must start with the last letter of the previous word; no repeats.
core_loop: read the last word → type one that starts with its last letter → pass the turn
rules: no repeated words
must start with the last letter
lose: timer runs out on your turn
social_hooks: Turn-based with friends in a group chat; the chain grows with each message.

name: Word ladder
summary: Change one letter at a time to turn a start word into an end word.
core_loop: change one letter → it must be a real word → step toward the target
rules: one letter changes per step
every step is a real word
social_hooks: Share your step count; fewest steps wins.
example_prompts: turn cold into warm one letter at a time

name: Letter tiles on a bonus board
summary: Place letter tiles on a board with bonus squares, crossing existing words to score.
core_loop: pick tiles from your rack → place them crossing a word → score with bonus squares → refill
rules: new words must connect to the board
bonus squares multiply letters or words
win: highest score when tiles run out
social_hooks: Async turns with friends, like Words With Friends.
example_prompts: letter tiles with double word squares

name: Letter merge
summary: Slide letter tiles together to form words that clear the board.
core_loop: letters drop → slide them into place → spell a word in a row → it clears
rules: a valid word in a line clears
the board fills if you're slow
social_hooks: Score attack with a weekly group board.
example_prompts: letter blocks fall and you spell words

name: Fill the missing letters
summary: Fill blanks in a word or phrase where some letters are hidden.
core_loop: See a word or phrase with some letters blanked out, type the whole answer, and reveal one more letter at a cost if you're stuck
rules: the shown letters stay in place
social_hooks: Make a set about your friends and send it.
example_prompts: guess the band with no vowels
fill in the blanks movie titles

name: Emoji rebus
summary: Guess the phrase, title or name from a row of emoji or picture clues.
core_loop: read the emoji clue → type the phrase → reveal a letter if stuck
rules: spelling is fuzzy-matched
hints cost points
social_hooks: Write emoji clues for friends; they guess.
example_prompts: emoji puzzles about our friend group

name: Word association
summary: Say a word linked to the last one; the chain must stay connected or you're out.
core_loop: read the last word → type a linked word → group can challenge weak links
rules: links must be explainable
no repeats
social_hooks: Pass-and-play or group chat turns; group votes on weak links.
example_prompts: link words to get from cat to rocket

name: One-word team clues
summary: A clue giver says one word and a number to point teammates at their words on a grid while avoiding the bad ones.
core_loop: clue giver gives one word and a number → teammates tap words → avoid the other team's and the trap
rules: one-word clues only
tapping the trap word loses
win: find all your team's words first
social_hooks: Team play across a group: two sides, shared board.

name: Guess the secret word together
summary: Players try to guess a defender's secret word letter by letter by making contact on other words.
core_loop: describe the word without the forbidden words → teammates type guesses → beat the timer
rules: forbidden words can't be used
social_hooks: Party game for a Group; teams take turns.
example_prompts: taboo without saying the forbidden words
describe the word without saying it

name: Spell what you hear
summary: Hear or see a definition and spell the word correctly.
core_loop: hear or read the word → type its spelling → harder words follow
rules: exact spelling only
social_hooks: Class or family leaderboard.

name: Decode the cipher
summary: Crack a substitution cipher to reveal a quote by mapping letters.
core_loop: guess a letter mapping → the quote updates everywhere → reveal the quote
rules: one letter always stands for the same letter
social_hooks: Encode a message for friends to crack.

name: Stack words to build a tower
summary: Type words that connect to the top word to add floors; the tower falls if you're too slow.
core_loop: read the top word → type a connected word → the tower grows → speed up
rules: each word must link to the one below
social_hooks: Height leaderboard among friends.

name: Rhyme time
summary: Find words that rhyme with a prompt before time runs out.
core_loop: A prompt word appears; type as many real rhymes as you can before the timer ends, with longer or rarer rhymes scoring more
rules: near rhymes count less
social_hooks: Rhyme-off battles between two friends.
example_prompts: how many words rhyme with cat

name: Hidden words in a sentence
summary: Find words hidden across the spaces of a sentence.
core_loop: read the sentence → drag across a hidden word spanning spaces → find them all
rules: hidden words cross word boundaries
social_hooks: Write sentences hiding your friends' names.
example_prompts: find the hidden animal in each sentence

name: Letter box
summary: Use letters around the sides of a square; consecutive letters must come from different sides; use all letters in few words.
core_loop: pick letters from alternating sides → spell words that chain → use every letter
rules: consecutive letters from different sides
each word starts with the last letter of the one before
win: use every letter within the word target
social_hooks: Compare how few words each friend needed.
example_prompts: use all the letters on the square

name: Combine syllables
summary: Join syllable tiles into words; every tile must be used.
core_loop: read a clue → combine syllable tiles into the answer → use every tile
rules: every tile used exactly once
social_hooks: Daily shared puzzle with group times.

name: Shared prefix or suffix
summary: Find the letters that complete every word in a set.
core_loop: see word fragments → type the letters that complete them all → next set
rules: the same letters complete every word
social_hooks: Streak sharing.
example_prompts: what letters complete all these words

name: Finish the lyric
summary: Complete the missing words in a familiar line of a song or quote.
core_loop: read the line with blanks → type the missing words → next line
rules: wording is fuzzy-matched
social_hooks: Party mode: pass the phone, sing the answer.
example_prompts: fill in the missing words of the song

name: Fake definitions
summary: Write a fake definition for an obscure word; others vote for which definition is real.
core_loop: see an obscure word → write a convincing fake definition → vote for the real one
rules: you can't vote for your own
points for fooling others and for finding the truth
scoring: points for correct votes and for fooling others
social_hooks: Group party game: everyone writes, everyone votes.

name: Acronym backronyms
summary: Write a funny phrase for a random acronym; the group votes on the best one.
core_loop: see random letters → write a phrase using them as initials → vote on the best
rules: words must start with the given letters in order
social_hooks: Group voting each round.
example_prompts: make a phrase from these letters

name: Word golf
summary: Reach a target word in as few word associations or letter changes as possible.
core_loop: start at a word → make a linked step → reach the target in few steps
rules: each step must follow the link rule
win: reach the target at or under par
social_hooks: Compare par with friends.
example_prompts: get from apple to rocket in fewest steps

name: Add the vowels
summary: Read phrases with all vowels removed and guess them.
core_loop: read a phrase with vowels removed → type the full phrase → next
rules: spacing can be misleading
social_hooks: Buzzer race among friends.

name: Write within a constraint
summary: Write a sentence or word that meets a rule (no letter E, exactly 10 letters, alliteration).
core_loop: read the rule → write a word or sentence that follows it → it's checked or voted on
rules: the rule is checked automatically when possible
social_hooks: Friends rate each other's entries.
example_prompts: write a sentence without the letter e

name: Tiles into a quote
summary: Rearrange chunks of letters into a hidden quote or phrase.
core_loop: drag letter chunks into columns → the quote forms → solve it
rules: each column's letters only fall into that column
social_hooks: Send a quote from your group chat as a puzzle.
example_prompts: rearrange the pieces into a quote
build the movie quote from tiles

name: Semantic hot and cold
summary: Guess a secret word; each guess is ranked by how close in meaning it is.
core_loop: guess a word → see its closeness rank → guess closer → find the word
rules: rank is by closeness in meaning, not spelling
social_hooks: Daily shared word; compare guess counts.
example_prompts: guess the word, see how close in meaning

name: Draw and guess
summary: One player draws a word, others guess it by typing.
core_loop: drawer draws the prompt → guessers type answers → first right answer scores both
rules: no letters or numbers in the drawing
social_hooks: Group party game: take turns drawing for each other.

name: Word slot machine
summary: Spin letter reels and stop them to make the highest-scoring word.
core_loop: spin the letter reels → stop each reel → make the best word → score
rules: each reel stops on one letter
the word must use the reels in order
social_hooks: Best word of the day in the group.

name: Riddles
summary: Answer a riddle by typing the answer.
core_loop: Read a short riddle, type the answer, and spend a hint to reveal a letter or a nudge if you're stuck; fewer hints means more points
rules: answers are fuzzy-matched
hints cost points
social_hooks: Send a riddle to a friend; see who solved it first.
example_prompts: what am i riddles for kids

name: Finish the pun
summary: Pick or type the punchline that completes a pun.
core_loop: Read a pun's setup, pick or type the punchline, then the group votes on the best wordplay among everyone's answers
rules: punchlines must be a pun
scoring: points per right answer or vote
social_hooks: Group votes on the best punchlines.

name: Word bomb
summary: Type a word containing the shown letter cluster before the bomb goes off; pass it on.
core_loop: see a letter cluster → type a word containing it → pass the bomb before it blows
rules: no repeated words
the fuse is hidden
lose: the bomb blows on your turn
social_hooks: Pass-the-bomb in a group; last one standing wins.
example_prompts: type a word with 'ing' before it explodes

name: Palindromes
summary: Build or spot words and phrases that read the same both ways.
core_loop: see letters or a prompt → build a word or phrase that reads the same both ways → it's checked
rules: spaces and punctuation are ignored
social_hooks: Group wall of best palindromes.

name: Spot the misspelling
summary: Find the misspelled word in each list or sentence.
core_loop: Scan a list or sentence and tap the one misspelled word before the timer; each round gets longer and the typos subtler
rules: exactly one word per round is wrong
social_hooks: Streak challenge.

name: Word lock
summary: Spin letter dials on a lock to form the one valid word that opens it.
core_loop: Spin several letter dials until the letters across them spell the one valid word that opens the lock; fewer spins score more
rules: exactly one valid word opens the lock
social_hooks: Daily lock with group times.
example_prompts: spin the dials to make a word
